by:
prep. 被, 經, 由, 在...之旁
adv. 經過, 在近處
r. so as to pass a given point

語感
中性
詞根詞綴
古英語 be、bi，屬日耳曼語源，沒有拉丁或希臘詞根可拆
字族
bier (名詞)
常見搭配
by law；by mistake；by the way；by and large；by yourself；paid by the hour；go by bus
注意事項
by 5:00 是「不晚於五點」，指截止時間，與 at 5:00 不同；被動句的 by 引出動作者
易混字
buy／by：buy 動詞「買」；by 介系詞「藉由、在…旁邊、不遲於」
by／bye：by 介系詞「藉由、在…旁邊」；bye 感嘆詞或名詞「再見」（多作 goodbye 的簡稱）
by-election:
n. 遞補選舉
[法] 補選, 缺補選舉
n. a special election between regular elections
by-product:
n. 副產品, 額外收穫, 意外收穫
[計] 副產品

n. a secondary and sometimes unexpected consequence
n. a product made during the manufacture of something else
bye:
interj. 再會, 回頭見
[計] 結束命令
n. you advance to the next round in a tournament without playing an opponent

<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>口語、非正式；「輪空」義用於體育</dd><dt>詞根詞綴</dt><dd>1700–1800 年間 goodbye 的縮短形</dd><dt>常見搭配</dt><dd>Bye now；get a bye into the second round</dd><dt>近義詞</dt><dd>goodbye：較完整，口語與書面都能用</dd><dt class="w">注意事項</dt><dd class="w">bye 和 by、buy 同音；體育的 bye 是「輪空，直接晉級」</dd><dt>易混字</dt><dd>by／bye：by 介系詞「藉由、在…旁邊」；bye 感嘆詞或名詞「再見」（多作 goodbye 的簡稱）</dd></dl>
byelaw: n. 規則, 條例, 內部規則
bygone:
n. 過去的事, 往事
a. 過去的

n. past events to be put aside
s. well in the past; former
<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>中性，帶懷舊色彩，多修飾 age、era、days</dd><dt>詞根詞綴</dt><dd>複合字：by「過去」＋ gone「逝去的」</dd><dt>常見搭配</dt><dd>a bygone age／era；bygone days</dd></dl>
bylaw: n. a rule adopted by an organization in order to regulate its own affairs and the behavior of its members
<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>中性，用於法律或組織規章</dd><dt>詞根詞綴</dt><dd>古北歐語 bylög，由 byr「城鎮」＋ lög「法律」組成，屬日耳曼語源，原指地方法規</dd><dt class="w">注意事項</dt><dd class="w">指地方政府或組織自訂的規章，位階低於國家法律；組織章程義字典標為美式</dd></dl>
byline: n. 副業, 署名報道
<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>中性，新聞出版用語</dd><dt>詞根詞綴</dt><dd>by「由…（寫）」＋ line「行」的複合字</dd></dl>
bypass:
n. 旁路
vt. 省略, 繞過, 忽視, 迴避

n. a surgically created shunt (usually around a damaged part)
v. avoid something unpleasant or laborious

<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>整體中性；名詞「旁路」偏英式，「心臟繞道手術」為醫學用語</dd><dt>常見搭配</dt><dd>heart bypass surgery；a triple bypass；bypass the town；take the bypass</dd><dt class="w">注意事項</dt><dd class="w">動詞可指繞過道路，也可指跳過規定或上級（bypass the manager），後者帶有「不照程序來」的意味</dd></dl>
bypast:
v avoid something unpleasant or laborious
s well in the past; former
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">中古英語（蘇格蘭方言），源自 2by＋past</dd></dl>
bypath: n a side road little traveled (as in the countryside)
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">中古英語，源自 2by＋path</dd></dl>
byproduct:
n a secondary and sometimes unexpected consequence
n a product made during the manufacture of something else
byrd:
n. English organist and composer of church music; master of 16th century polyphony; was granted a monopoly in music printing with Thomas Tallis (1543-1623)
n. explorer and United States naval officer; led expeditions to explore Antarctica (1888-1957)
byron: n. English romantic poet notorious for his rebellious and unconventional lifestyle (1788-1824)
byssinosis: n. 綿纖維吸入性肺炎
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">新拉丁語，源自後期拉丁語 byssinum（亞麻衣服；源自拉丁語 byssinus 的中性形式）＋新拉丁語 -osis</dd></dl>
byssus: n. 古代的亞麻布, (貝類的)足絲
n tuft of strong filaments by which e.g. a mussel makes itself fast to a fixed surface
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">拉丁語 byssus，源自希臘語 byssos（亞麻），源出閃米特語；同源於希伯來語 būṣ（亞麻布）</dd></dl>
bystander:
n. 旁觀者, 目擊者
[法] 候補陪審員, 旁觀者
<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>中性</dd><dt>詞根詞綴</dt><dd>by「在旁」＋ stander（stand「站」）</dd><dt>常見搭配</dt><dd>an innocent bystander</dd><dt>近義詞</dt><dd>onlooker：旁觀的人，強調在場觀看</dd></dl>
byte:
n. 位元組, 位組
[計] 位元組
n. a sequence of 8 bits (enough to represent one character of alphanumeric data) processed as a single unit of information

<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>中性，電腦專門術語</dd><dt>詞根詞綴</dt><dd>20 世紀的人造字，並非來自拉丁或希臘詞根</dd><dt class="w">注意事項</dt><dd class="w">1 byte 通常為 8 個 bit；中文常見譯名為「位元組」</dd><dt>易混字</dt><dd>bite／byte：兩字同音；bite 動詞或名詞「咬、一口」；byte 名詞「位元組」（電腦儲存單位）</dd></dl>
byway: n. 旁道, 偏僻小路
n. a side road little traveled (as in the countryside)

<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>中性</dd><dt>詞根詞綴</dt><dd>字首 by-「旁邊」＋ way「路」</dd><dt>常見搭配</dt><dd>highways and byways；the byways of legal history</dd><dt class="w">注意事項</dt><dd class="w">也可比喻某個領域冷僻的部分</dd></dl>
byword: n. 諺語, 俗話, 笑柄
n a condensed but memorable saying embodying some important fact of experience that is taken as true by many people
